sentences: Having to pay for redelivery just doesn't sit right with me
Still, I take the trouble to think about how to receive my packages, so honestly, I think it's wrong that I pay the same fee as people who are always away and ask for redelivery
Charging for redelivery means the person receiving the package pays a fee on top of the usual shipping cost
It's convenient to pick them up when it suits me, but for some items, I can't choose a locker
And even when I ask for a package to be sent to a delivery office, it may arrive late, so I sometimes end up receiving it in person after all

items.source_sentence: Having to pay for redelivery just doesn't sit right with me
items.source_sentence_ja: 再配達に料金を払わなければならないのは、どうも納得がいきません。

items.source_sentence: Still, I take the trouble to think about how to receive my packages, so honestly, I think it's wrong that I pay the same fee as people who are always away and ask for redelivery
items.source_sentence_ja: それでも、荷物の受け取り方を考えるよう手間をかけているので、正直、いつも不在で再配達を頼む人たちと同じ料金を払うのはおかしいと思います。

items.source_sentence: Charging for redelivery means the person receiving the package pays a fee on top of the usual shipping cost
items.source_sentence_ja: 再配達を有料にするということは、荷物を受け取る人が通常の送料に加えて料金を支払うということです。

items.source_sentence: It's convenient to pick them up when it suits me, but for some items, I can't choose a locker
items.source_sentence_ja: 自分の都合に合わせて荷物を受け取れるのは便利ですが、品物によってはロッカーを選べません。

items.source_sentence: And even when I ask for a package to be sent to a delivery office, it may arrive late, so I sometimes end up receiving it in person after all
items.source_sentence_ja: また、荷物を配達営業所に送ってもらうよう頼んでも、到着が遅れることがあり、結局、自分で直接受け取ることになる場合もあります。
